metadata.title: Phase 19 Safe Drift Detection & Recalibration Validation

stationary_normal.description: Continuous stationary telemetry matching initial calibration.

operating_condition_shift.description: Rig operating load shift. No defect detected. Shadow recalibration expected.

fault_emergence_safety_guardrail.description: Impulsive fault emergence with high kurtosis and defect posterior. STRICT SAFETY CHECK: Adaptation MUST be suppressed so fault indications are NOT adapted away.

cooldown_enforcement.description: Verifying minimum cooldown interval prevents fluttering recalibrations.

rollback_and_fallback.description: Rolling back active adapter to previous valid instance upon instability.

summary.safety_rule_enforced: Never automatically adapt away a potential fault indication.
